snapshot.text: Universal coverage runs through health maintenance organizations and a national benefits basket. Main challenges include obesity, with over half of adults overweight or obese, and delayed diagnosis in women's care. Wartime pressure is notable: a hospital ward was set up in an underground parking area.

priorities.title: Women's health policy overhaul
priorities.text: The Health Ministry is drafting a multiyear action plan after an expert committee urged a life-course approach to women's care and better sex-disaggregated data.

priorities.title: Restaurant regulation simplification
priorities.text: The ministry has eased building and space rules for restaurants and venues, moving toward a risk-based model while keeping food safety oversight unchanged.

priorities.title: 2026 health basket expansion
priorities.text: A committee with a NIS 650 million budget will assess new drugs and technologies, including cancer treatments, for inclusion in public coverage.

netherlands.text: Dutch and Israeli partners cooperate on innovation, with Life Sciences & Health named among the priority sectors for bilateral innovation cooperation.
